mentions.name: Rasterly
mentions.description: This web app dynamically visualizes massive drone and satellite aerial imagery of any size in the browser, and can calculate and display spectral indexes. It lets users share large aerial imagery without recipients needing to download anything.
mentions.problem: Sharing large aerial imagery typically requires recipients to download the files first.
mentions.audience: Drone surveyors, conservationists, researchers, and similar users who need to share aerial imagery.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Visualize massive aerial images on the web: https://rasterly.com

I started building Rasterly as a side-project to be able to dynamically visualize drone and satellite imagery of any size. You can calculate and view spectral indexes too!
